title: Layout uses the Classic theme
description:
Layout-quality rule — a layout still uses the deprecated Classic theme. Classic layouts render with legacy metrics, miss modern style features and slow down WebDirect.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "Object with classic style" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: The Classic theme is deprecated since FileMaker 12 — it renders with legacy metrics, supports no modern styles and slows WebDirect rendering.
rule.remediation: Migrate the layout to a current theme and re-apply styles deliberately; check the layout visually afterwards.
